1350-2793-6495-6871.description:
Cast Ugin's Nexus by paying {5}.
At the beginning of your end step, Toph triggers, causing Ugin's Nexus to become an artifact land creature.
Activate Evereth by sacrificing Ugin's Nexus. Ugin's Nexus is exiled instead of being put into your graveyard, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Toph triggers, returning Ugin's Nexus from exile to the battlefield.
Resolve the Evereth ability.
Activate Meticulous Excavation by paying {1}{U}, returning Ugin's Nexus from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat each turn.

1829-1981-2415-6797.description:
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing a creature
When the creature dies, Vindictive Vampire and Havoc Jester trigger.
Resolve the Vindictive Vampire trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and dealing 1 damage to each opponent
Resolve the Havoc Jester trigger, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on it and causing it to become a Spirit artifact creature in addition to its other types until end of turn.
Repeat.

215-391-2404-7895.notablePrerequisites: You control at least six creatures.
215-391-2404-7895.description:
Activate Gaea's Cradle by tapping it, adding at least six {G}.
Activate Temur Sabertooth by paying {1}{G}, returning Little Bear to your hand.
Cast Little Bear by paying {2}{G}.
When Little Bear enters, it triggers itself, untapping Blossom Dryad.
Activate Blossom Dryad by tapping it, untapping Gaea's Cradle.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite green mana, you may activate Temur Sabertooth any number of times and recast any creatures castable with green mana any number of times, effectively "blinking" your green creatures any number of times.
You may also activate Blossom Dryad any number of times.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

6798-6972-7825.description:
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing Bifur.
When Bifur dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Bifur enters, it triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability.
Repeat.
6798-6972-7825.notes: If you have an enduring story, Bifur will trigger twice, and the other counter can be placed on whatever creature you desire.

2021-2060-2445-6260.description:
Activate Simic Ascendancy by paying {1}{G}{U}, putting four +1/+1 counters on Crystalline Crawler.
Simic Ascendancy triggers, putting growth counters on it.
Activate Crystalline Crawler's second ability by removing three +1/+1 counters from it, adding {1}{G}{U}.
Repeat.
At the beginning of your next upkeep, Simic Ascendancy triggers, causing you to win the game.

2103-4125-7370.description:
Cast Capture of Jingzhou by paying its mana cost.
Kykar triggers, exiling Shipwreck Dowser.
Resolve Capture of Jingzhou, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
At the beginning of your end step, Kykar triggers, returning Shipwreck Dowser from exile to the battlefield.
When Shipwreck Dowser enters, it triggers, returning Capture of Jingzhou from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat each turn.

2999-4186-7743.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
2999-4186-7743.description:
Gain life.
Heroic Feast triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Scurry Oak
Scurry Oak triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters the battlefield, Impassioned Orator triggers, causing you to gain life.
Repeat from step 2.

2034-5003-7505.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Patagia Viper, adding {C}{C}.
When Patagia Viper dies, Nim Deathmantle triggers, causing you to pay {4} to return Patagia Viper from your graveyard to the battlefield and attach Nim Deathmantle to it.
When Patagia Viper enters, it triggers twice.
Resolve the first trigger, creating two creature tokens.
Holding priority, activate Ashnod's Altar twice by sacrificing Patagia Viper and a creature token, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}
Repeat from step 2.

2438-4559-7306-7430.notablePrerequisites:
Noncreature artifacts you control have total mana value 11 or greater.
You've had two creatures die under your control this turn.
2438-4559-7306-7430.description:
Cast Metalwork Colossus by paying {0}, which enters with at least two +1/+1 counters on it due to Gorma.
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Metalwork Colossus.
When Metalwork Colossus dies, Gorma and The Ooze trigger.
Resolve The Ooze's trigger, creating a Mutagen token for each +1/+1 counter Metalwork Colossus had.
Resolve Gorma's trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability.
Activate Metalwork Colossus by sacrificing two Mutagens, returning it from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

339-677-4460-6797.description:
Activate Jegantha by tapping it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G} that cannot be spent to pay generic mana costs.
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing Jegantha.
Activate Horde of Notions by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}, causing you to cast Jegantha from your graveyard without paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

2034-4929-5224-7183.description:
Cast Cryptic Trilobite by paying {1}, causing it to enter the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Together Forever by paying {1}, targeting Cryptic Trilobite.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Cryptic Trilobite, adding {C}{C}.
When Cryptic Trilobite dies, Together Forever triggers, returning Cryptic Trilobite from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

225-1409-1671-2895.manaNeeded: {1}{G}{U} plus enough mana to pay for commander tax, if applicable
225-1409-1671-2895.description:
Cast Uro by paying {1}{G}{U}
When Uro enters the battlefield, its first and second abilities trigger, as well as Deadeye Navigator's soulbond ability.
Resolve the Deadeye Navigator trigger, pairing it and Uro.
Resolve the second Uro trigger, causing you to draw a card, gain 3 life, and put Simic Growth Chamber from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Simic Growth Chamber enters, it and Stone-Seeder Hierophant trigger.
Resolve the Stone-Seeder Hierophant trigger, untapping it.
Holding priority, activate Stone-Seeder Hierophant by tapping it, untapping Simic Growth Chamber.
Holding priority, activate Simic Growth Chamber by tapping it, adding {G}{U}.
Resolve the Simic Growth Chamber trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Activate Uro by paying {1}{U}, blinking it.
Repeat from step 2.

1062-3487-5636-5674.notablePrerequisites: You have at least 3 land cards in your hand.
1062-3487-5636-5674.description:
Activate Psychic Frog by discarding a land card.
Slogurk triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Psychic Frog ability.
Repeat from step 1 two additional times.
Activate Slogurk by removing three +1/+1 counters from it, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
When Slogurk leaves the battlefield, it triggers, returning three land cards from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Slogurk by paying {E} due to Primal Prayers.
When Slogurk enters, Aetherstorm Roc triggers, causing you to get {E}.
Repeat.

3525-4474-6858.description:
Activate Oreskos Sun Guide by tapping it, adding {U}.
Activate Pemmin's Aura by paying {U}, untapping Oreskos Sun Guide.
Oreskos Sun Guide triggers, causing you to gain 2 life.
Repeat.

4056-4679-4948--82.description:
Activate the mana-producing creature by tapping it, adding at least {2}.
Activate Yenna by paying {2} and tapping it, creating a token copy of Estrid's Invocation. Choose to have Estrid's Invocation enter the battlefield as a copy of Second Wind attached to the mana-producing creature. Then, untap Yenna and scry 2.
Activate the Second Wind token's second ability by tapping it, untapping the mana-producing creature.
Repeat.
4056-4679-4948--82.notes: If the creature being tapped for mana can add {3} or more, this combo will net infinite mana of those color(s) and type(s).

4826-5413-5531-6621.easyPrerequisites: Other lands you control can tap to produce at least {4}{C}.
4826-5413-5531-6621.description:
Activate any number of other lands by tapping them, adding at least {4}{C}.
Activate Trenching Steed by sacrificing a land except Mirrorpool.
Repeat step 2 until you control no lands except Mirrorpool.
Activate Mirrorpool's third ability by paying {4}{C}, tapping and sacrificing it, creating a token copy of Lumra.
Put the Lumra token into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
The Lumra token's enters-the-battlefield ability triggers, causing you to mill four cards and return all land cards from your graveyard to the battlefield untapped due to Archelos.
Repeat.

856-2267-4050-5776.description:
Activate Cauldron Familiar by sacrificing a Food.
Ygra triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Resolve the Cauldron Familiar ability, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Cauldron Familiar and Tormod trigger.
Resolve the Tormod trigger, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Cauldron Familiar trigger, causing each opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Cauldron Familiar.
When Cauldron Familiar dies, Ygra triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Repeat.

38-659-1115.notablePrerequisites: You control a number of Goblins that is equal to or greater than six plus Krenko's commander tax.
38-659-1115.description:
Activate Krenko by tapping it, creating a number of 1/1 Goblin creature tokens equal to the number of Goblins you control.
Activate Skirk Prospector by sacrificing Krenko, adding {R}.
Choose to return Krenko to the command zone from your graveyard.
Activate Skirk Prospector by sacrificing a Goblin, adding {R}.
Repeat step 4 until you have enough mana to cast Krenko.
Cast Krenko from the command zone by paying {2}{R}{R} plus commander tax.
Repeat.

509-1267-1379-4883.manaNeeded: {1}{U}{R} available the first turn, with {4} each extra turn
509-1267-1379-4883.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
509-1267-1379-4883.description:
Deal combat damage to an opponent using Medomai the Ageless.
Medomai the Ageless triggers, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Cast Idris by paying {1}{U}{R}.
When Idris enters the battlefield, it triggers, exiling Medomai the Ageless until Idris leaves the battlefield.
Move to your extra turn.
At the beginning of your upkeep, Idris's vanishing ability triggers, removing a time counter from it.
Activate Contagion Clasp by paying {4} and tapping it, putting a time counter on Idris.
Deal combat damage to an opponent using Idris.
Idris triggers, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat from step 5.

2617-4613-4939-5917.notablePrerequisites:
Midnight Guard has at least one +1/+1 counter on it.
Midnight Guard does not have summoning sickness.
2617-4613-4939-5917.description:
Activate Midnight Guard using The Jolly Balloon Man's ability by paying {1} and tapping it, creating a token copy of Burning-Tree Emissary that is a 1/1 Balloon with flying and haste in addition to its other types.
When the Burning-Tree Emissary token enters the battlefield, it and Midnight Guard trigger.
Resolve the Burning-Tree Emissary token's trigger, adding {R}{G}.
Resolve the Midnight Guard trigger, untapping it.
Repeat.
2617-4613-4939-5917.notes: Once you have infinite mana, you may target any other creature using step 1 instead.

1692-3617-5730.notablePrerequisites: Helm of the Host attached to Aberrant Mind Sorcerer.
1692-3617-5730.description:
Cast Time Walk by paying {1}{U}, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
At the beginning of your combat phase, Helm of the Host triggers, creating a token copy of Aberrant Mind Sorcerer with haste.
When the Aberrant Mind Sorcerer token enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to roll a d20 and either return Time Walk from your graveyard to your hand, or put Time Walk from your graveyard on top of your library.
Move to your extra turn, drawing Time Walk if it was put on top of your library.
Repeat.

2557-2757-5685.description:
Activate a basic Forest by tapping it, adding {G}.
Activate Propagator Drone by paying {3}{G}, creating two 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature tokens.
Activate Earthcraft by tapping an Eldrazi Spawn, untapping a basic Forest.
Activate the basic Forest by tapping it, adding {G}.
Activate Earthcraft by tapping an Eldrazi Spawn, untapping the basic Forest.
Activate the Eldrazi Spawns by sacrificing them, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat.

1448-1636-2034-5198-5220.notablePrerequisites: Bogbrew Witch does not have summoning sickness.
1448-1636-2034-5198-5220.description:
Activate Bogbrew Witch by paying {2} and tapping it, searching your library for Festering Newt and putting it onto the battlefield.
When Festering Newt enters the battlefield, Intruder Alarm triggers, untapping all creatures.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Festering Newt, adding {C}{C}.
When Festering Newt dies, it and Mortuary trigger.
Resolve the Festering Newt trigger, giving any creature an opponent controls -4/-4 until end of turn.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Festering Newt on top of your library from your graveyard.
Repeat.

112-1455-4636.description:
Cast Clockspinning with buyback by paying {3}{U}, targeting Gonti's Aether Heart.
Vesuvan Duplimancy triggers, creating a token copy of Gonti's Aether Heart that isn't legendary.
When the token Gonti's Aether Heart enters the battlefield, each Gonti's Aether Heart you control triggers, causing you to get {E}{E} for each Gonti's Aether Heart you control.
Resolve Clockspinning, returning it to your hand.
If you have less than eight {E}, repeat from step 1 one additional time.
Activate a Gonti's Aether Heart token by paying eight {E} and exiling it, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

1636-3113-3590.notablePrerequisites:
Fire Whip attached to Warchanter Skald.
Warchanter Skald does not have summoning sickness.
1636-3113-3590.description:
Activate Warchanter Skald using the Fire Whip ability by tapping it, choosing any target.
Warchanter Skald triggers, creating a 2/1 Dwarf Berserker token.
Intruder Alarm triggers, untapping all creatures.
Repeat.

65-717-1583-2628-4652.description:
Activate Drifting Meadow's cycling ability by paying {0} and discarding it.
Bone Miser, Drifting Meadow, and Escape Protocol trigger.
Resolve the Bone Miser trigger, adding {B}{B}.
Resolve the Drifting Meadow trigger, drawing a card.
Resolve the Escape Protocol trigger, causing you to pay {1} to blink Tilling Treefolk.
Tilling Treefolk enters the battlefield, returning Drifting Meadow and up to one other land from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.
